notes.title: November 2019, Update Announcement
notes.notes:
November 2019, Update Announcement

Hello, Heroes.
This is Team 'Next Hero'.

'Next Hero' v1.0.7 update has been completed.

Please see the patch note below for the details.

[Update Content] 
- "Hell knight Blond" costume has been added. (Available after clearing 'Hell Mode')
- Copyright Notice has been updated.
- Minor Bug fixes.

Thank you for playing 'Next Hero'.

Team Next Hero

notes.title: July 2018, update announcement
notes.notes:
Hello. Heroes
This is ‘Next Hero’

We appreciate your concerns and playing ‘Next Hero’.
‘Next Hero’ v1.0.6 update has been completed.

Please refer to the patch note shown below.

[Update Content]
High end content ‘Challenge Mode’ has been added.
1.	How to play
-	If you have ever slayed a dragon, you can challenge the new mode.
-	Lobby -> New game -> Challenge mode

2.	Introduction
-	At the beginning, 10 monsters show up in a zone.
-	A random item will be dropped when you wipe them out.
-	A Stage consists of 4 waves.
-	Monsters will invade until ‘Blond’ gets knocked down.
-	The further stages you reach, more scores you will achieve.
-	You may see your score and rank on leaderboard.

Survive with various items and challenge the highest rank!

Thank you.

Next Hero Team

notes.title: April 2018, update announcement
notes.notes:
Hello. Heroes
This is ‘Next Hero’

We appreciate your concerns and playing ‘Next Hero’.
As we announced before, ‘Next Hero’ update has been completed.

Our heroes now may challenge the ‘Hard’ and ‘Hell’ mode with higher grade items.
Please refer to the patch note shown below.

[Update Content]
1.	‘Hard’ mode
-	Once you clear ‘Normal’ mode, Heroes may challenge ‘Hard’ mode.
-	Incoming damage is doubled
-	Amount of monsters show in a zone and HP of Boss monster are increased
-	Attack pattern of certain boss monster gets more difficult to avoid.
-	Drop rate of Higher grade item is increased.
-	Once you clear ‘Hard’ mode, you can wear ‘Dragon knight’ costume.

2.	‘Hell’ mode
-	Once you clear ‘Hard’ mode, Heroes may challenge ‘Hell’ mode.
-	Incoming damage is doubled. Maximum HP is limited to 5.
-	Amount of monsters show in a zone and HP of Boss monster aredrastically increased.
-	Attack pattern of certain boss monster gets more difficult to avoid.
-	Drop rate of Higher grade item is increased compared to ‘Hard’ mode
-	Once you clear ‘Hard’ mode, you will get ‘Hell Knight’ costume.
‘Hell Knight’ costume will be available after next update.

[System Improvement]
1.	Remained round for colosseum will be shown on the screen.
2.	You can now check the play time (Start-Restart).

[Balance]
1.	For Beginner Heroes, the cost for town construction is decreased again.
2.	Heroes will not get harmful effect from potion and dice anymore on ‘Normal’ mode.

notes.title: April 2018 Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello. Heroes
This is ‘Next Hero’

We appreciate your concerns and playing ‘Next Hero’.
‘Next Hero’ Dev team is currently preparing for April update.
Before the update, we have come with the update preview.

1. First of all, our heroes might know that ‘Easy mode’ of ‘Next Hero’ is too easy.
‘Hard mode’ and ‘Hell mode’ are waiting for our expert Heroes.
Once you clear the ‘Easy Mode’, you have chance to challenge the ‘Hard Mode’ and ‘Hell Mode’.
Take your weapons, save the town and be greater Hero!

2. New costumes will be added for ‘Hero Blond’
Once you obtain the costumes, they are 100% free to wear, 
Take your time to meet the brand new costumes.


There will be also updates for balance and improvements of user interfaces.
We will soon comeback with the detailed update announcement.

Thank you.
Next Hero Team

notes.title: Update announcement (03/23/2018)
notes.notes:
Hello, Heroes
This is ‘Next Hero’.

Thank you for your playing ‘Next Hero’.
We have monitored your review and to provide better content, ‘Next Hero’ update has been completed.
Please refer to the patch note shown blow.

Thank you.
Next Hero Dev Team

[Changes]
 - From now, you can get gold and keys from objects like trees.
 - If Blond has only basic weapon(sword), you will get a weapon from the first box you find.
 - Meriln started getting rid of his greed according to visits of many heroes.
Overall cost of town construction has been drastically decreased.
 - You can see the ability and the additional stats on description of items
